properties.notes: Planning Ref: 07/01426/FULMAJ (2009-06-12); 1/00875/FULMAJ (2012-01-19). Land remediation and contamination works started in 2015 however construction of the dwellings has not yet started. An email from the applicant states that terms have been agreed with a housebuilder and construction of the dwellings is expected to start around April 2018. Assuming a completion rate of 30 dwellings per annum, 120 dwellings would be completed in the five year period.. Erection of 149 dwellings
